trello.name: Venue Contract and AV Confirmation
trello.desc: Diego needs to get the venue contract through legal review and signed by the end of next week. Additionally, confirm in writing that the AV package includes recording capabilities in all three rooms to avoid last year's issue of missing breakout talk recordings.

trello.name: Speakers Confirmation
trello.desc: Bo needs to send final follow-ups to the two 'maybe' speakers with a decision deadline of Friday. In case of any declines, refer to the backup list of five names. Ensure the speaker lineup is locked in two weeks to facilitate agenda printing.

trello.name: Keynote Abstract Acquisition
trello.desc: Bo to contact Dr. Osei to obtain the keynote abstract within this week. The abstract is needed for both the website and the printed program.

trello.name: Email Campaign Drafting and Scheduling
trello.desc: Diego will draft three waves of the email campaign by the end of the month. The first wave will go out on the day the agenda is live, followed by a reminder two weeks before the early-bird deadline, and a final push in the last week before the event.

trello.name: Speaker Pages Update
trello.desc: Once Bo locks the speaker lineup, immediately provide Diego with all relevant bios and headshots to update the landing page on the same day. This must be completed before the first wave of the email campaign.

trello.name: Swag Order Placement
trello.desc: Camille to review and approve the design proofs for the swag items stored in the shared drive today. Once approved, Diego will place the order this week to ensure timely delivery, considering the six-week lead time observed last year.
